verifications.claim: National Siblings Day is celebrated annually on April 10th.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "it takes place on April 10 every year" (R1); "on April 10th each year" (R2); "April 10" (R3); "on 10th April" (R4); "every April 10" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: All references directly state or confirm the date as April 10 annually.

verifications.claim: National Siblings Day was founded by Claudia Evart in 1995 to honor her late siblings.
verifications.label: AMBIGUOUS
verifications.evidence: "In 1995... Claudia Evart, founded National Siblings Day to honor... her two siblings" (R2); "created in 1997 by Claudia Evart" (R3); "Claudia Evart created the US holiday in 1995 after losing her brother and sister" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: R2 and R5 support 1995 and honoring late siblings; R3 contradicts with 1997.

verifications.claim: Claudia Evart selected April 10th in memory of her late sister, Lisette.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Claudia selected April 10th in honor of her late sister, Lisette's birthday" (R2); "April 10, which is the birthday of the founder’s late sister, Lisette" (R3); "Claudia chose April 10 — her late sister Lisette’s birthday" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple references directly confirm the selection of the date for Lisette's memory.

verifications.claim: National Siblings Day is not a federal holiday.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Although it is not an official holiday like Mother’s Day and Father’s Day" (R3); "working to make the holiday federally recognized in the United states" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: References imply and support it is not federally recognized/official by stating efforts to achieve that status.

verifications.claim: Governors in 49 states have issued proclamations to recognize National Siblings Day.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "governors of 49 states have officially issued proclamations" (R3); "49 states have issued gubernatorial proclamations" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Both references directly state the exact detail of 49 states' governors issuing proclamations.

verifications.claim: Popular social media hashtags for National Siblings Day include #NationalSiblingsDay and #SiblingLove
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: "Use #NationalSiblingsDay to post on social media" (R2); "#nationalsiblingsday" (R3); "#NationalSiblingsDay2026" (R4); no mention of #SiblingLove
verifications.reasoning: References clearly support #NationalSiblingsDay as a hashtag but do not mention #SiblingLove, making support partial and less precise.
